sections.title: Level 1
sections.heading: Level 1 — Seedling 🌿
sections.subheading: Warm up with the basics. A 5th grader gets these right.

questions.label: A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 run away. How many are left?
Which of these does a plant NOT need to grow?
If you plant a seed 2x deeper, does it grow 2x taller?
options: No — depth doesn't work that way
Depends on the brand of seed
questions.correctOption: No — depth doesn't work that way

sections.title: Level 2
sections.heading: Level 2 — Farmhand 🚜
sections.subheading: Now think like someone who has actually stepped on soil.

questions.label: A drip line waters 40 plants using 2 litres/hour. Sprinklers use 9 litres/hour for the same plants. Roughly how much water does drip save in 5 hours?
Your tomato leaves turn yellow from the bottom up. The most likely first suspect?
Why do farmers rotate crops between seasons?
options: Soil nutrients recover and pest cycles break
questions.correctOption: Soil nutrients recover and pest cycles break

sections.title: Level 3
sections.heading: Level 3 — Agronomist 📈
sections.subheading: The 90% fail here. Slow down and think in systems.

questions.label: A vertical farm stacks 6 layers in 180 sq ft. Each layer yields 80% of open-field yield per sq ft. Total yield vs the same 180 sq ft open field?
A drone maps 100 acres and flags 12 stressed zones. Spraying everything costs ₹60,000; targeted spraying costs ₹800/zone + ₹15,000 drone ops. What should the farmer do?
Biogas digester input drops 30% in winter. Gas output falls 45%. The disproportionate drop is most likely because…
options: Bacteria slow down in cold — biology is temperature-sensitive
Cows produce premium dung only in summer
questions.correctOption: Bacteria slow down in cold — biology is temperature-sensitive
